metadata.title: Women and Child Safety Departments & Facilities in Pune
metadata.description: Geographical coordinates, contact details, jurisdictions, and operational roles of government administrative offices, police safety cells, judicial bodies, crisis intervention centers, and emergency helplines for women and child safety in Pune.

properties.name: Commissionerate of Women and Child Development (WCD), Government of Maharashtra
properties.department: Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Maharashtra
properties.address: 28, Queen's Garden, near Old Circuit House, Camp
properties.role: State apex headquarters responsible for the formulation, implementation, and monitoring of policies, legislation, and welfare schemes for women and children across Maharashtra, including Mission Shakti, Mission Vatsalya, and POSH Act compliance.

properties.name: State Adoption Resource Agency (SARA), Maharashtra
properties.department: Commissionerate of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra
properties.address: Commissionerate of Women and Child Development, 28 Queen's Garden, Camp
properties.role: State nodal statutory body coordinating, regulating, and monitoring in-country and inter-country adoption of orphaned, abandoned, and surrendered children under CARA guidelines.

properties.name: Maharashtra State Commission for Women (Pune Regional Desk)
properties.department: Maharashtra State Commission for Women (Statutory Body)
properties.address: Divisional Commissioner Office Complex, Council Hall, Camp
properties.role: Investigating violations of women rights, resolving complaints regarding violence, dowry harassment, sexual abuse, and providing free legal advice and family counseling.

properties.name: District Women and Child Development Office (DWCDO), Pune
properties.department: Revenue & Forest / WCD Department, Government of Maharashtra
properties.address: Chunawala Chambers, Abdul Ajiz Memon Path, Tophakhana, Shivajinagar
properties.role: District-level executive machinery overseeing women safety shelters, anti-child marriage enforcement, POSH Internal Committees inspections, child institutions registration, and child protection programs.

properties.name: District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Pune
properties.department: Women and Child Development Department / Mission Vatsalya
properties.address: Bungalow No. 5, Param Anand, near Old Circuit House, Queen's Garden, Camp
properties.role: Field-level child protection body managing rescue operations for children in distress, street children, child laborers, child abuse victims, foster care, sponsorship, and institutional rehabilitation.

properties.name: Pune City Police - Bharosa Cell Headquarters (Cops Hub)
properties.address: Old CID Office Building, Sangam Bridge, near Sangamwadi Road, Shivajinagar
properties.role: Pioneering integrated police center offering crisis support, legal consultation, psychiatric counseling, and dispute resolution for women, children, and senior citizens under one roof.

properties.name: Pune City Police Headquarters - Women Safety Desk & Damini Squad HQ
properties.address: Police Commissioner Office, 2 Sadhu Vaswani Road, Agarkar Nagar, Camp
properties.role: Headquarters of the dedicated all-women rapid intervention bike/patrol squad (Damini Pathak) securing schools, colleges, IT parks, bus stands, and public spaces, alongside the 24x7 Women Control Room.

properties.name: Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU), Pune City Police
properties.address: Crime Branch, Police Commissioner Office, Sadhu Vaswani Road, Camp
properties.role: Specialized juvenile protection police unit enforcing the Juvenile Justice Act, investigating POCSO cases, missing children complaints, and coordinating with CWC and juvenile homes.

properties.name: Pimpri Chinchwad Police - Bharosa Cell & Women Safety Wing
properties.address: Police Commissioner Office, Premlok Park Road, Indira Nagar, Bhoirnagar, Akurdi / Chinchwad
properties.role: Comprehensive women and child protection desk, domestic counseling, and emergency intervention for the industrial twin cities of Pimpri-Chinchwad and surrounding suburban zones.

properties.name: Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Pune District
properties.department: Department of Women & Child Development / Judicial Bench
properties.address: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Udyog Kendra (PJNUK) Campus, M10, Golf Club Road, Ashok Nagar, Yerawada
properties.role: Statutory bench with powers of a First Class Judicial Magistrate to decide the care, custody, rehabilitation, and long-term protection of children in need of care and protection (CNCP).

properties.name: Juvenile Justice Board (JJB) & Juvenile Court, Pune
properties.department: District & Sessions Court / Women & Child Development
properties.address: M10, Golf Club Road, Ashok Nagar, Yerawada
properties.role: Special judicial tribunal comprising a Principal Magistrate and two social workers adjudicating cases involving Children in Conflict with Law (CCL), focusing on counseling, reform, and rehabilitation.

properties.name: Government Observation Home & Children's Home (PJNUK Bal Kalyan Sankul)
properties.department: Commissionerate of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra
properties.address: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Udyog Kendra, Golf Club Road, Ashok Nagar, Yerawada
properties.role: State-run residential care, protective shelter, schooling, and vocational rehabilitation facility for juveniles undergoing inquiry and children requiring emergency state protection.

properties.name: Family Court, Pune (Matrimonial & Child Custody Center)
properties.department: Judiciary of Maharashtra / High Court of Bombay
properties.address: Husseny Building, 89, 107/2, Nyaymurti Ranade Path, Tophakhana, Shivajinagar
properties.role: Adjudicating matrimonial disputes, granting domestic violence protection orders, maintenance, divorce, child custody, and conducting mandatory family mediation with trained counselors.

properties.name: Sakhi One Stop Centre (OSC), Pune
properties.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development (GoI) / Chaitanya Mahila Mandal
properties.address: 1st Floor, Bharat Ratna Late Rajeev Gandhi Hospital, Deccan College Road, Nawanagar, Salwe Nagar, Yerawada
properties.role: 24x7 emergency one-stop crisis shelter for women facing domestic violence, sexual assault, harassment, or distress, providing integrated emergency medical care, police reporting, legal counseling, and temporary lodging.

properties.name: Childline 1098 Nodal Centre Pune (Karve Institute of Social Service)
properties.department: Childline India Foundation / Ministry of WCD / Karve Institute
properties.address: Karve Institute of Social Service, 18, Hill Side, Hingane Home Colony, Karvenagar
properties.role: Nodal coordinating center for 1098 Child Helpline in Pune, executing field rescues for runaway, abused, child-labor, and child-marriage victims, legal follow-ups, and psychological rehabilitation.

properties.name: Childline Collaborative Outreach Centre (Deep Griha Society)
properties.department: Deep Griha Society / Mission Vatsalya Childline
properties.address: 13, Tadiwala Road, Lumbini Nagar, Sangamvadi, near Pune Railway Station
properties.role: Outreach collaborative partner for Childline Pune focusing on high-risk vulnerable zones, railway station surveillance for runaway children, slum outreach, child health support, and crèches.

properties.name: Pune Municipal Corporation - Social Development & Women Welfare Department
properties.role: Planning and executing civic women welfare schemes, women self-help groups (SHG / Bachat Gat) financial assistance, mother & child nutritional support, girl-child education subsidies, and free vocational centers.

properties.name: Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation - Women and Child Welfare Department
properties.address: PCMC Main Administrative Building, Mumbai - Pune Road, Pimpri Colony
properties.role: Civic department administrating women empowerment programs, maternity benefit schemes, day-care crèches for children of working women, and specialized child nutrition centers in PCMC limits.
